permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.purpose: Show watering reminders and weather-risk notifications after user approval.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.purpose: Resolve an approximate device region for local weather after separate in-app location consent. Manual region selection remains available.

permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
permissions.purpose: Capture a plant photo only after the user chooses the camera path. The system photo picker requires no broad storage permission.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.purpose: Use Firebase authentication, sync, callable functions, storage, messaging, identification, and weather services.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.purpose: Apply network-aware retry and offline behavior for Firebase and background work.

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
permissions.purpose: Support device-protected credential flows offered by the Google identity stack.

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT
permissions.purpose: Provide legacy fingerprint compatibility for device-protected credential flows.

permissions.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
permissions.purpose: Allow bounded processing of an incoming push notification.

permissions.name: com.google.android.providers.gsf.permission.READ_GSERVICES
permissions.purpose: Support Google Play services configuration used by identity and messaging dependencies.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
permissions.purpose: Restore eligible scheduled background work after device restart.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.purpose: Permit WorkManager to run user-visible long-running work when Android requires foreground execution.

permissions.name: com.planterior.helper.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
permissions.purpose: Protect app-internal dynamically registered broadcast receivers from external callers.

technicalDisclosureCandidates.notes: Collected when the user elects Google or Apple sign-in; guest use is supported.
Identification originals, optional representative photos, and optional mini-home share images have different retention boundaries in the obligation map.
Requires OS coarse-location permission plus separate app consent; manual region is an alternative.
First-party allowlisted analytics is default-off and contains no free-form values.
Plant, watering, mini-home, and share content exists only when the user creates it.
FCM installation and registration identifiers are used for optional notifications.

obligations.sourceLabel: Identification originals (abandoned, no terminal state reached)
Location (device region + weather state derived from it)

requiredExternalLaunchInputs.instruction: Provide the final public privacy-policy URL in Play Console and release metadata. Do not replace this null with an invented URL.
Provide the public web account-deletion request/instructions URL required by Play. The in-app deletion flow does not replace this external URL requirement.
Supply through the protected release environment; never place values in this packet or build logs.
Register the production app/signing certificates and enable the Play Integrity App Check provider in the production Firebase project.
Confirm current contracts and Play definitions before converting technical transfers into final shared/not-shared declarations.

signingCertificateSha256.outputContract: One colon-delimited uppercase SHA-256 certificate fingerprint; no password or private-key bytes.

sourceAndHistorySecretScan.outputContract: Exit 0 after both complete-history and tracked-plus-untracked-current-source scans.

temporaryReleaseVerification.outputContract: Exit 0 after fail-closed auth/signing fixtures, APK/AAB/APKS build, manifest inspection, signer equality, R8 class retention, and artifact secret/provider-key scan. Uses only generated verification credentials.

aabSignatureVerification.outputContract: Exit 0 with a signed JAR/AAB; compare its signer SHA-256 with the approved upload certificate before upload.

apksSignatureVerification.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); unzip -q app-release.apks -d "$tmp"; find "$tmp" -type f -name '*.apk' -exec "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/37.0.0/apksigner" verify --verbose --print-certs {} \;; status=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $status
apksSignatureVerification.outputContract: Every generated APK exits 0 and reports the approved signing-certificate SHA-256. Temporary extraction is removed.

bundleManifestInspection.outputContract: Manifest reports package com.planterior.helper, versionCode 1, versionName 0.1.0, minSdk 29, and targetSdk 37.

rolloutChecklist.gate: All required external launch inputs resolved in protected systems
Privacy policy and account deletion HTTPS pages publicly reachable and content reviewed
Play Console app content, permissions, Data safety, content rating, target audience, ads, and access declarations completed
Production Firebase Android app, SHA-256 certificates, Auth providers, Storage, Functions, Messaging, and Play Integrity App Check configured
Production AAB built fail-closed and source/history/artifact secret scans pass
AAB signer matches approved Play upload certificate and generated APKS signatures verify
Internal testing install exercises Google/Apple auth, App Check, photo identification, storage, sync, notifications, privacy controls, and account deletion
Pre-launch report and device compatibility findings reviewed with no release blocker
Staged rollout starts at operator-approved percentage with crash/ANR/auth/App Check/backend monitoring and halt criteria assigned
Rollout expansion requires stable metrics and an explicit human approval at each stage
